name: Pilot
summary: A personal browser-automation agent. You describe a goal, and it navigates sites in your own logged-in browser, extracts what matters and compiles the result.
highlights: Turns live pages into compact, stable DOM summaries the agent targets by ref ID, with a vision fallback for canvas pages
Records the first successful run as a recipe that replays deterministically with zero model calls
Pauses risky actions for approval and never handles passwords; supports local LLMs via Ollama

name: SacredSafe
summary: A local-first, encrypted password manager. Everything stays on your machine with no accounts, sync or telemetry.
highlights: AES-256-GCM vault encryption with PBKDF2 key derivation (310k iterations)
Cryptographically random password and username generators

name: Protect Your Plot
summary: A squad-command lane-defense autobattler: hire peasants to defend your plot against beasts, soldiers and plague.
highlights: Squad-command unit control on top of lane-defense waves

name: Weekly Schedule
summary: A native Android weekly planner. Lay out your week in time blocks, and a persistent notification always shows what you should be doing right now.
highlights: Google Calendar-style week grid: drag across days to create the same block on several days at once
Two notification modes: a locked, un-swipeable notification, or reminders on a chosen interval
Alarms re-arm after reboots, updates and time-zone changes; unit-tested scheduling logic

name: LinkWatch
summary: A desktop app that scrapes a set of URLs on a schedule, tracks which links are new and shows the results on a daily, weekly or monthly timeline.
highlights: Per-source schedules with active hours and keyword title filters
Test runs preview results without touching saved history

name: This site
summary: Static portfolio and daily blog generated from Markdown by a small Node build script, deployed on GitHub Pages and Vercel.

name: Restaurant Location Finder
summary: Streamlit app that maps nearby restaurants with location search and cuisine filters, using OpenStreetMap data.

name: TreeNodes
summary: A game with animals categorized in a tree structure, built around tree traversal.

name: ClueGame
summary: Java implementation of Clue with a Swing GUI, AI players and JUnit tests (with Levi Sprung).
